name: osf-cli-go
description: Read-only MCP tools for authenticated Open Science Framework projects and files.
long_description: OSF CLI Go exposes read-only Model Context Protocol tools for inspecting an authenticated Open Science Framework account, projects, components, OSF Storage files, and contributors.

tools.name: osf_whoami
tools.description: Return the authenticated OSF user profile.

tools.name: osf_projects_list
tools.description: List projects owned by the authenticated OSF user.

tools.name: osf_project_get
tools.description: Get an OSF project or component by id or URL.

tools.name: osf_components_list
tools.description: List immediate child components for an OSF project or component.

tools.name: osf_files_list
tools.description: List OSF Storage files and folders.

tools.name: osf_contributors_list
tools.description: List contributors for an OSF project or component.

tools.name: osf_search
tools.description: Search public and authenticated OSF content.

tools.name: osf_preprints_list
tools.description: List OSF preprints, optionally filtered by provider.

osf_token.title: OSF personal access token
osf_token.description: Preferred OSF authentication token. Create one at https://osf.io/settings/tokens/.

osf_username.title: OSF username
osf_username.description: Optional fallback username when no OSF token is provided.

osf_password.title: OSF password
osf_password.description: Optional fallback password when no OSF token is provided.
